newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Info says signs China telecom MOU.
newsitem.headline: LG Info says signs China telecom MOU.

text.p: South Korea's LG Information and Communication Co said on Monday it has signed a memorandum of understanding with a Chinese firm to produce code division multiple access (CDMA) telecommunication equipment from 1997.
"We've signed a MOU with China National Post and Telecommunications Industry Corp (PTIC) and now have to settle the details of the contract," said an LG Information public relations official.
LG Information was also shortlisted as one of six candidates to supply PTIC with CDMA equipment, a company statement said.
The other candidates are Motorola Inc, Qualcomm Inv, Lucent Technologies Inc, Northern Telecom Ltd and a division of Samsung Electronics, it said.
LG Information is a unit of the LG Group.
